ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the query is a benign content-generation request (drafting a job description) with no sensitive or harm-adjacent material, so safety-tuning differences between the models are irrelevant. That leaves raw capability as the tiebreaker, and Willet-235B is the stronger model across the board — higher public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4, MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8) and a meaningfully higher Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 78.8, beyond the 2.0-point variance threshold). Since serving cost and latency are identical across the fleet, there's no tradeoff to weigh against choosing the more capable model.
